inputs.active_core_r_scope: All direct current carriers in Core 04_requirement with status Active; source types include Entity Definition, Rule, Relation Definition, Term Definition and Demand. Archive/draft folders excluded.

decision_constraints.node_scope: One Declaration for each entity in Node/, including every declared Property; each Property explicitly states direct-value Format/cardinality and dependent-Property cardinalities. Do not redeclare inherited Properties. Actual Workflow/Step/Substep/Action instances are deferred.
decision_constraints.classification: Do not mechanically map an old Entity path to Node. Separate Primary kind, Property kind, classification axis/value, actual instance, and syntax/Carrier/Term evidence.
decision_constraints.new_syntax_name: GFEL (Graphs Formal Expression Language). Older Current vocabulary remains source evidence; this report assigns no migration mapping.
decision_constraints.Draft_schema: Current Draft frontmatter may retain admitted legacy content_role/type keys as Draft metadata; model declarations use Role/Form terminology.
decision_constraints.Draft_form: Formal Claim first; prose Claim only for constraints not expressible formally; brief Semantics only for Primary Nodes; simple English and lists for parallel conditions.

structural_kind_families.disposition: Entity includes every primary graph node and every Property; branches include Object, Aspect, Graph Syntax, Carrier, Term and Property. It explicitly says not every Entity is an Object and does not establish disjoint/exhaustive categories.
Object specializes as Continuant or Occurrent. These are existing kind families, not proof that every old Object path maps to proposed Node.
Aspect is a topic through which Atom addresses a thing, not another copy of the thing.
Property is dependent on exactly one immediate bearer; it may itself bear Properties. Keep separate from primary-value independence classification and do not infer Node identity.

Graph Syntax defines expression constructs and does not create instances; Carrier is representation, not described node; Term is lexical/reusable and is outside the Node branch absent explicit disposition.
Atom is defined as the smallest independently governed Artifact and is a Continuant. It is a strong source binding candidate for an Atom Declaration but not a blanket Entity-to-Node mapping.

primary_kind_candidates.basis: Metadata grouping only from the previous active Entity Definition census; Object and Aspect are review candidates, not approved Node mappings.
